n01.text: This is Bloom Break. A breathing break, with a little bonsai.

n02.text: A small garden, all around you. You stay seated, and use only your hands.

n03.text: A firefly shows each gesture in light. Pinch the seed to plant it.

n04.text: Tilt the can to pour, and your tree begins to grow.

n05.text: Trim the glowing shoots, one by one, to shape your bonsai.

n06.text: In less than three minutes, it blooms.

n07.text: Care matters. Too much water, and the leaves turn yellow and droop.

n08.text: Cut a healthy branch, and the tree grows tense.

n09.text: But it never dies. Breathing with it brings it back.

n10.text: Every few minutes, a short pause. Close your eyes, and breathe.

n11.text: When you open them, the garden has changed.

n12.text: It follows your real season, and your time of day.

n13.text: Choose a three, five, or ten minute break. Hold to select, one hand, high contrast. Subtitles, always on.

n14.text: No pinch? Just look, or hold your hand still.

n15.text: Come back tomorrow, for a daily gift, and new levels.

n16.text: And one big tree, shared by everyone who visits.
